title: Media and advertising — core set
titleVi: Truyền thông và quảng cáo — bộ từ cốt lõi
description: Bộ từ về cách báo chí đưa tin, cách nhãn hàng tiếp cận người tiêu dùng và những hệ quả xã hội của cả hai. Học xong bạn sẽ bàn được về truyền thông mà không rơi vào những câu chung chung kiểu "media is important".
ieltsUse: Dùng cho Task 2 các đề về quảng cáo, báo chí, mạng xã hội và ảnh hưởng của truyền thông tới trẻ em; cũng hữu ích khi bàn về chủ nghĩa tiêu dùng.

words.vi: chủ nghĩa giật gân (đưa tin phóng đại để câu khách)
words.def: the use of shocking or exaggerated stories to attract attention
words.example: Tabloid sensationalism often distorts crime statistics rather than explaining their causes.

words.vi: báo lá cải, báo khổ nhỏ
words.def: a small-format newspaper that focuses on celebrities and shocking stories
words.example: Tabloid coverage of celebrity scandals can distract readers from serious political debate.

words.vi: báo khổ lớn (báo nghiêm túc)
words.def: a large-format newspaper known for serious news and analysis
words.example: Broadsheet editorials still shape public opinion among older, educated readers.

words.vi: bình luận gia, chuyên gia bình luận trên truyền thông
words.def: a person who gives expert opinions in the media
words.example: Political pundits predicted a close election, yet the result was decisive.

words.vi: sự kiểm duyệt
words.def: the official control of information published or broadcast
words.example: Strict censorship of the press undermines public trust in government institutions.

words.vi: tuyên truyền (nhằm gây ảnh hưởng chính trị)
words.def: information spread to promote a political cause or point of view
words.example: State propaganda during the campaign presented every policy as an unquestionable success.

words.vi: sự chứng thực; việc người nổi tiếng quảng bá sản phẩm
words.def: a public statement supporting a product, person or idea
words.example: Celebrity endorsement of unhealthy snacks has been blamed for rising childhood obesity.

words.vi: biển quảng cáo lớn ngoài trời
words.def: a large outdoor board used for advertising
words.example: Billboards advertising fast food dominate the skyline of many busy urban districts.

words.vi: giờ vàng (khung giờ nhiều người xem nhất)
words.def: the hours when most people watch television
words.example: Advertisers pay premium rates to reach families during prime time.

words.vi: đối tượng khán giả mục tiêu
words.def: the particular group of people an advert or programme aims to reach
words.example: The campaign's target audience is parents of primary-school children.

words.vi: việc lồng ghép sản phẩm vào phim, chương trình
words.def: paid inclusion of a branded product within a film or programme
words.example: Product placement allows brands to advertise without interrupting the viewer's experience.

words.vi: chủ nghĩa tiêu dùng
words.def: a culture that encourages people to buy goods in large quantities
words.example: Rising consumerism has accelerated the depletion of natural resources worldwide.

words.vi: dưới ngưỡng ý thức (tác động mà không nhận ra)
words.def: affecting the mind without the person being aware of it
words.example: Subliminal advertising is banned in several countries because it manipulates choice.

words.vi: thời lượng phát sóng
words.def: the amount of time given to a programme or speaker on radio or television
words.example: Minority languages receive very little airtime on commercial channels.

words.vi: số lượng phát hành (của một tờ báo)
words.def: the number of copies of a newspaper sold
words.example: Newspaper circulation has fallen sharply since readers moved to online news.

words.vi: bài xã luận
words.def: an article giving the newspaper's own opinion on an issue
words.example: The editorial argued that advertising to children should be tightly regulated.

words.vi: tiêu đề giật tít dụ người đọc nhấp chuột
words.def: online content with an exaggerated headline designed to attract clicks
words.example: Clickbait headlines spread misinformation faster than verified reporting.

words.vi: người có ảnh hưởng trên mạng xã hội
words.def: a social media user who can persuade a large audience to buy things
words.example: Brands now pay influencers more than they spend on traditional television adverts.

words.vi: sự tài trợ (để đổi lấy quảng cáo)
words.def: financial support for an event in return for advertising
words.example: Corporate sponsorship of sporting events has become a major revenue stream.

words.vi: chiến dịch quảng cáo
words.def: a planned series of adverts promoting a product or idea
words.example: A nationwide advertising campaign persuaded millions to switch to electric cars.

words.vi: tập đoàn truyền thông
words.def: a large company that owns many newspapers, channels and platforms
words.example: A handful of media conglomerates now control most of what the public reads.

words.vi: thông tin sai lệch (lan truyền, không cố ý lừa)
words.def: false or inaccurate information spread without intent to deceive
words.example: Governments must tackle online misinformation without silencing legitimate criticism.

words.vi: đài truyền hình công lập
words.def: a state-funded channel expected to serve the whole public
words.example: A well-funded public broadcaster can offer educational programmes commercial channels ignore.

words.vi: mốc giờ sau đó mới được phát nội dung dành cho người lớn
words.def: the time after which adult television content may be broadcast
words.example: Violent films are shown only after the watershed, when children are usually asleep.

words.vi: câu nói ngắn được trích trên truyền thông
words.def: a short, memorable phrase quoted from a longer speech
words.example: Complex policy debates are reduced to thirty-second soundbites on the evening news.

words.vi: nhạc hiệu quảng cáo
words.def: a short tune used to advertise a product
words.example: A catchy jingle can keep a brand in consumers' minds for decades.
